blockingFindings.title: Changed commandId cache-miss coverage is not isolated
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires a changed commandId to be treated as a cache miss, but the executable test only changes commandId together with other identity inputs such as provider/provider profile mapping. A cache implementation that ignores commandId could still pass if the provider/profile change causes the miss.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add one R3 assertion where only commandId changes while provider, profileKey, resolved invocation identity, systemPrompt, userPrompt, jsonSchema, and fmtFallback remain identical, and verify the provider is invoked again.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a must requirement dimension with no corresponding isolated spec-local regression coverage, so an implementation can omit commandId from the cache key and still satisfy the current tests.
